thread:
alex.m: Kicking off phased geofence rollout now — US -> EU -> APAC. Pinning model v2.3.1 for US slice. @lina can you confirm capacity headroom for US and EU?

deploy-bot: Started rollout: slice=us-1, target=10% traffic, model=v2.3.1, status=initiated

lina.s: US pool A: 72% used, safe headroom ~25% if we enable burst; EU pool B: 65% used, headroom ~18% with current autoscale. APAC pools under maintenance window till 02:00 UTC — recommend holding APAC.

omar.k: +1 on holding APAC. Suggest gating EU after we validate 5m SLOs for US. If p95 latency >200ms for 5m, trigger rollback.

jamie.t: Also confirm KV cache invalidation is disabled for canary to avoid cold starts. rollout config I pushed:
```yaml
rollout:
  slices:
    - region: us
      pct: 10
      pin: v2.3.1
    - region: eu
      pct: 0
    - region: apac
      pct: 0
  metrics:
    latency_p95_ms: 200
    duration_min: 5
```

alex.m: Perfect. Starting US canary window. Notifying SRE and product ops. Keeping EU and APAC pinned at 0 for now.

deploy-bot: Slice us-1 progressed to 10% traffic, status=healthy, start_ts=1977777782

sre-bot: Alert: EU region p95 latency spike observed at 1977777788: 232ms over 1m (source=infra-proxy). No errors flagged yet.

lina.s: seeing the EU spike in graphs, cause looks like transient queueing on model shard eu-gpu-2. Scaling +2 nodes now, ETA ~90s.

omar.k: Hold EU rollout. Do not advance to EU until p95 <200ms for 5m. If spike persists, rollback EU slice (if any) to v2.3.0.

alex.m: Understood. Rolling back any EU slices and keeping US at current canary.

deploy-bot: Rollback executed: region=eu, from=v2.3.1 to=v2.3.0, status=complete, ts=1977777824

lina.s: EU rollback complete. Latency starting to normalize. APAC still blocked by maintenance window.

alex.m: Final state: US at 10% stable, EU rolled back to v2.3.0, APAC on hold until maintenance ends. Post-rollout notes: follow-up to run a 30% US stress test tomorrow, enable burst for US pool if needed. Adding a postmortem checklist to the release doc. :white_check_mark:
